messages.content: Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

**August engineering update**

The Postgres migration is done. We moved the last three services off the old cluster on the 19th, and the read replicas have held steady since. p95 query latency dropped from 340ms to about 90ms, better than we projected. Nobody worked a weekend for it, which is worth saying out loud, because both previous attempts cost us one.

Two people joined. Priya started on platform on the 4th and has already shipped the retry logic in the ingest worker. Tom joined data on the 18th and is still ramping. If you haven't paired with either of them, grab half an hour this month.

The reporting rewrite slipped. We said end of August; realistically it lands mid-October. The reason is that a lot of the old aggregation logic turned out to be undocumented business rules rather than code, and each one needs a human to confirm before we can port it. I don't think a version of this existed where we hit the original date. Sales knows, and they're fine.

Next month: finish reporting, and get Tom through his first solo on-call shift.

Questions, or things I got wrong, come find me. I'd rather hear it now than in the retro.
Rewrite the text above. Keep the same length and the same purpose. Return only the rewritten text.

**August engineering update**

We finished the Postgres migration. The last three services came off the old cluster on the 19th, and the read replicas have been steady ever since. p95 query latency went from 340ms to roughly 90ms, which beats what we told you to expect. No one gave up a weekend for it. That's worth naming, since the two earlier attempts each cost someone one.

Two new people. Priya joined platform on the 4th and has already landed the retry logic in the ingest worker. Tom joined data on the 18th and is still getting his bearings. Book half an hour with each of them this month if you haven't yet.

The reporting rewrite is late. We promised end of August; the honest date is mid-October. What happened: most of the old aggregation logic turned out to be undocumented business rules, not code, and someone has to confirm each rule before we can port it. I don't believe there was a version of this that hit the original date. Sales has been told and isn't worried.

September: ship reporting, and get Tom through his first solo on-call rotation.

If you have questions, or I got something wrong, come tell me. Better now than at the retro.
